name: Almond Tree
overview: The almond tree in Scripture symbolizes God's power to bring life and fruitfulness, as seen in Aaron's rod that budded and yielded almonds, affirming divine approval and authority (Numbers 17:8). Its distinctive shape inspired the design of the golden candlestick in the tabernacle, where bowls fashioned like almond blossoms adorned the branches, reflecting God's beauty and order in worship (Exodus 25:33-34; 37:19-20). Additionally, almonds were valued as a precious fruit and gift, illustrating God's provision and blessing in the land (Genesis 43:11).
